requirements.statement: Native XML exports the three-component RC network.
Native placement violations and schematic parity have no issues; unrouted connectivity is ungraded.
Every courtyard is wholly inside the board outline.
Native DRC including connectivity and schematic parity has no issues.

No simulation, manufacturing qualification or complete campaign is claimed. Zone fill is graded as saved.
Expected seeded defects remain defects; fixture expectations never invert a production grade.
